info.name: Employee Salary Structure With Details Module - School Management System
info.description: Complete Postman collection for atomic creation of Employee Salary Structures along with their line item details in a single database transaction. Validates employee existence, prevents overlapping active salary records, auto-generates structure name based on employee designation, and validates component calculation rules.

item.name: 1. Create Salary Structure With Details (Standard Mix - Fixed & Percentage)

body.raw:
{
  "employee_id": 1,
  "effective_from": "2026-04-01",
  "effective_to": null,
  "status": "active",
  "remarks": "Standard faculty salary package FY2026-27",
  "components": [
    {
      "component_id": 1,
      "calculation_type": "fixed",
      "amount": 50000,
      "percentage": null,
      "based_on": "basic"
    },
    {
      "component_id": 2,
      "calculation_type": "percentage",
      "amount": null,
      "percentage": 40,
      "based_on": "basic"
    },
    {
      "component_id": 3,
      "calculation_type": "fixed",
      "amount": 3500,
      "percentage": null,
      "based_on": "basic"
    },
    {
      "component_id": 4,
      "calculation_type": "percentage",
      "amount": null,
      "percentage": 12,
      "based_on": "basic"
    }
  ]
}

request.description: Atomically inserts the header structure row and multiple line item details in a single database transaction. Overlapping structures and invalid/duplicate components are blocked.

item.name: 2. Create Salary Structure With Details (All Fixed Components)

request.description: Creates structure with all fixed component allowances.

item.name: 3. Create Salary Structure With Details (Singular Route Alias)

request.description: Demonstrates creation using the singular alias route `/api/employee-salary-structure-with-details`.

item.name: 4. Validation Test - Duplicate Component in Payload (Expect 400)

request.description: Tests rejection when duplicate component_ids are supplied in the same components array.

item.name: 5. Validation Test - Missing Required Components Array (Expect 400)

request.description: Tests rejection when the components list is empty or omitted.
